body_markdown:
Last year,


[Spotify Audiobook Selects](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/spotify-audiobook-selects-first-indie-releases/) introduced its first cohort of 16 short-form novellas written by independent authors. Now, the program is back with a new collection of stories centered around “swoon-worthy tropes.”


Spotify Audiobooks, our in-house audiobook publishing imprint, launched Audiobook Selects as a way to spotlight new voices and uplift independent authors. Authors submit their stories for consideration, and if selected, join the program with their work produced and distributed on Spotify and other audiobook retailers for listeners around the world.


The latest cohort features novelette-length stories that put a fresh spin on romance tropes like friends-to-lovers, grumpy/sunshine, and only one bed. Their shorter length makes them an easy entry point into the genre and a great audio companion as you go about your day.


Before you fall in love with their stories, get to know the new authors joining the Spotify Audiobook Selects program.


## [The Flower Shop of Failed First Love](https://open.spotify.com/show/0fE8uhh3VYffhbPwlywYBM?si=f39c59419f7a44c2&nd=1&dlsi=96b6517f89f0485c) **by Elizabeth Hrib**


Photo credit: Hanako Whiteway


**Hometown:** London, Ontario, Canada.


**My Select in one sentence:** A bite-sized rom-com of mythical proportions where a down-on-his-luck college student gets tangled up with the goddess of love.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:**[A Day of Fallen Night](https://open.spotify.com/show/5TOE6m8Ug8nkThuZ9Uwp6l) by


**Samantha Shannon** .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Cozy fantasy or anything with dragons.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Natalie Naudus** \[


[Japanese Gothic](https://open.spotify.com/show/72nql9mi2txsjp9tXIVYof) *,*[Fallow](https://open.spotify.com/show/2U0rwBW6zyc14C8LrtLpEd) \]


**Advice to my younger self:** Take that senior year creative writing class.


## [Love in the Air](https://open.spotify.com/show/3LZQ7kfjiyHJOpxLNrzBRY?si=31e15254002a4a28&nd=1&dlsi=40f76b5ec1ae437) **by Mariah Ankenman**


**Hometown:** Denver, Colorado.


**My Select in one sentence:** Rivals on the ground, lovers in the air!


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:**[The Jane Austen BBC Radio Drama Collection](https://open.spotify.com/show/2RwYMQNPmaiCKf0Mi4bCXD) .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Romance.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Sir Patrick Stewart** , RIP legend.


**Advice to my younger self:** Keep chasing joy. It will lead you on an extraordinary journey.


## [Bearly There](https://open.spotify.com/show/0hUo3kJgNDh4kXoNsF9Onn?si=c6b0915d8bb14f3f) **by Jennifer L. Hart**


Artwork credit: Gina Poff


**Hometown:** Scotia, New York.


**My Select in one sentence:** It was a rough day before he got hit by the VW.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:** Anything by


[Kresley Cole](https://open.spotify.com/author/7BdJFt9NCYxHW1DIUGXpab) ,


[Patricia Briggs](https://open.spotify.com/author/6wHiuiXFkt71A8xjXfFJk9) , or


[Anne Bishop](https://open.spotify.com/author/5gOQkEkL6E84NVA3XFkBIi) .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Paranormal romance.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Holter Graham** \[


[Christine](https://open.spotify.com/show/6uXpRW9p7R6cxDThMwoXnk) ,


[Danse Macabre](https://open.spotify.com/show/223dBT6iZhACVtUSGyQLhI) \]


**Advice to my younger self:** The only one standing in your way is you.


## [Kissed Him Anyway](https://open.spotify.com/show/4o3WTPsAQq58A4K8OU81Oe?si=96e6bf46417240c0) **by** **Megan Linski**


Photo credit: Erica Berger


**Hometown:** Michigan!


**My Select in one sentence:** Figure skater Lainey travels through time to save her hockey star soulmate from a tragic fate.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:**[Murder at the Magic Academy](https://open.spotify.com/show/7tnakj4Gxha4b96xqjBzV1) by


**Alicia Rades** .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Fantasy.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Tim Curry** .


**Advice to my younger self:** Persistence in the face of immense obstacles is the most important trait you can ever attain.


## [A Lord’s Guide to Mutiny, Marriage, and Mistletoe](https://open.spotify.com/show/0ptRahDenxrJLppxzNfSwH?si=fc4d236f67444d94) **and**[The Fiercest Pirate in Surrey](https://open.spotify.com/show/3tbPqW3GpGgRIiSIWBkXB0?si=40d66a33794d41ea) **by Anne Knight**


Photo credit: Rachel Cottom Bondor


**Hometown:** Little Rock, Arkansas.


**My Selects in one sentence:** Change happens because of love, and only when we all participate.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:**[Marrying Winterborne](https://open.spotify.com/show/0CknEzz3cldhZpsgfdvkXO) by


**Lisa Kleypas** .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life** : Historical fantasy romance.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Mary Jane Wells** \[


[Queen of Lombard Street](https://open.spotify.com/show/2UtCNrfj346x4qqn9ojKmp) *,*[The Duchess Deal \]](https://open.spotify.com/show/7EUApgOWuzVJE6wYcX9Vu0)


**Advice to my younger self:** Success takes hard work, luck, and talent. You’ll experience all three at different times in your life. Keep everything in perspective—work hard, but know that sometimes things are outside of your control.


## [Heads or Tales](https://open.spotify.com/show/1ChhW74LTfANvp3DGHON1h?si=518d389fb8734981) **by S.M. Levine**


**Hometown:** Midwest, U.S.


**My Select in one sentence:** Two friends, one rideshare, zero room to escape their attraction.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:**[Robbie McNeil’s Hit List](https://open.spotify.com/show/4smJ4EOkpe14rNIr7UOPn7) *.*


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Romance.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Julia Whelan** \[


[My Year of Rest and Relaxation](https://open.spotify.com/show/0ETLdBRwD2uEUWqRAtl2rs) ,


[Hollywood, Ending](https://open.spotify.com/show/67T31pgiO83B7LZrrIMis8) \]


**Advice to my younger self:** When people tell you that your dream’s not possible, fight even harder for it!


## [Reuniting with the Rancher](https://open.spotify.com/show/6pz8nqSReA6HYnghOwPAZI?si=75990717d44a4eaa) **by Terreece M. Clarke**


**Hometown:** Toledo, Ohio, now living in Columbus.


**My Select in one sentence:** Two wounded and heartbroken former lovers reconnect against their will as secrets and heat boil to the surface.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends:**[August Lane](https://open.spotify.com/show/7ukw3b0kieba4zMriNdECb) by


**Regina Black** .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Romance, duh.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Jason Momoa** .


**Advice to my younger self:** Don’t overthink it. Your voice is important so put it out there, and get tested for ADHD.


## [Under The Millionaire’s Mistletoe](https://open.spotify.com/show/46F0NdLcvSVpPcI2IGgkeQ?si=64c13ec2d4754cf7) **,**[From Homecoming to Forever: Diary & Ace](https://open.spotify.com/show/7rjVfX14jCOZXtwwfOknDv?si=a38573677eac4270) **, and**[With Love, From Brooklyn](https://open.spotify.com/show/4WfEuqyH5cEey8lzYMUxYU?si=36264d02f39e43cd) **by Treasure Malian**


Photo credit: Ian Crumpler of Ian Alexander Photography


**Hometown:** Brooklyn, New York.


**My Selects in one sentence:** If it’s meant to be, it’ll be.


**Audiobook I recommend to friends** :


[A Love Song For Ricki Wilde](https://open.spotify.com/show/7iCEjjm3Dp66FJVOt9AU0s) .


**If I could read just one genre for the rest of my life:** Romance.


**Dream audiobook narrator, alive or dead:** **Bahni Turpin** \[


[Jazz](https://open.spotify.com/show/7zmt2PijTfXLlznODvQbrp) ,


[Children of Blood and Bone](https://open.spotify.com/show/7pe3ZGSRZPwybkQ9MHszY0) \]


**Advice to my younger self:** Stand firmly in who you know yourself to be. Do not allow current circumstances to sway you from believing in yourself, because broken crayons still color.


*Find these stories and more in the*[audiobook hub](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5IMCbQBLwTVtOgZkBKP) *on Spotify.* ****
